mips_delay_slot_v0.method: Hash-check cached keyman/mode/loader against prior durable evidence. Capstone MIPS32 decoder with ELF byte order; use owning executable section VA/file bias. Decode anchor and short post-call window, follow direct JAL to PLT stub, resolve GOT target through .rel.plt/.dynsym/.dynstr. Read lib/libc.so via unsquashfs -cat into memory only and inspect memcpy entry. No immediate key values emitted.
mips_delay_slot_v0.smips: Same keyman/mode/loader hashes and decoded offsets as mipsbe; fresh hash comparison succeeded for all 9 MIPS target files.
mips_delay_slot_v0.relocation: All four distinct JAL destinations resolve through .rel.plt relocation type 127 to memcpy. Stub: LUI t7; LW t9; JR t9; ADDIU t8 in JR delay slot. This stub neither consumes nor kills v0.
mips_delay_slot_v0.libc_entry: One exported memcpy symbol per libc; first instruction MOVE v0,a0 overwrites v0 before any use. Next instruction MOVE v1,a0.
mips_delay_slot_v0.conclusion: The narrow static concern that the real memcpy body consumes the final anchor word in v0 is resolved for these pinned cached libc bodies: JAL delay-slot SW occurs before callee entry and memcpy immediately kills v0. This is NOT a complete matcher/runtime safety proof; dynamic loader/lazy-binding path and alternate symbol resolution were not traced. Do not leave the local callee unresolved in parent notes, but do not claim production readiness.
remaining_blockers: No production or offline MIPS matcher/tests exist in inspected tree. Exact pinned envelope, strict ELF ownership, decoder boundaries, relocation/alias/direct or indirect entry and all-mapping overlap preflight still need implementation/review.

LUI/ADDIU requires signed low-half compensation: high=((word+0x8000)>>16)&0xffff, low=word&0xffff; ORI uses unsigned low half. Need synthetic boundary/carry/wrap tests, preserve opcodes/registers/arg setup and delay-slot store. No replacement was proposed or applied here.
MIPSBE/SMIPS keyman/mode use ADDIU on words 0,6,7; MMIPS uses ADDIU on words 0,1,5,7. Mixed ORI and ADDIU layouts must not be conflated.
Ten-limb loader anchor is not a supported transformation or a validated preservation policy. Its verifier/startup role and external uses remain unknown.
No identified 7.24.4 physical board boot/login/activation/persistence evidence found. Historical bootloop warnings are reports, not newly reproduced defects.

ppc.matcher: ppc_license.py accepts exactly two pristine whole-ELF hashes, keyman/mode only. ELF32 big-endian EM_PPC. Eight LIS/ORI/STW stores count as one 32-byte anchor; fixed interleaved setup and final r9 kill included. Relocation/direct-entry/metadata checks and decoder required; indirect-entry assumptions restricted to whole-file pins.
ppc.fresh_verification: 24 tests pass, 0 skip/failure/error in normal and -O with MIKPATCH_PPC_FIXTURES pointed to existing vendor cache. Pinned source reconstruction and memory-only synthetic substitution validated; production _replace_keys remains unchanged/zero instruction coverage, partial package cannot sign/save.

ppc.coverage_contract_correction: Current generic guard requires >=1 replacement for EACH mapping across entire system package, NOT every verifier/file. A keyman-only integration could satisfy the minimum and still leave mode/loader semantically unsupported. This is why earlier production integration was removed; completeness needs explicit product-scoped fail-closed policy, not guard bypass or inflated coverage.
